name: Booming Blade

source.note: Entered from knowledge of Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (first printed in Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide), a 2014-rules spell the owner added on 2026-10-07; no 2024 book reprints it. Check every number against the owner's copy.

components.m: a melee weapon worth at least 1 SP

targets.description: One creature within 5 feet, struck with the component weapon.

cantrip_scaling.text: Extra Thunder damage on a hit, none before level 5: 1d8 at level 5, 2d8 at 11, 3d8 at 17. The damage for moving grows with it: 1d8, then 2d8, 3d8 and 4d8.

summary: A melee weapon attack that wraps the target in thunder: if it moves of its own will before your next turn, it takes Thunder damage.
text: You brandish the weapon that is the spell's material component and make one melee attack with it against a creature within 5 feet of you, using the weapon's usual attack and damage. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects and is wrapped in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If it willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, it takes 1d8 Thunder damage and the spell ends. From character level 5 the hit also deals 1d8 extra Thunder damage and the damage for moving becomes 2d8; both grow by 1d8 at level 11 (2d8 and 3d8) and again at level 17 (3d8 and 4d8).
